text: Búanann is an Irish heroine or goddess. The early scholar Cormac called her the mother of heroes. That title is a common epithet for a goddess. She is an obscure figure whom some connect with deities of the land's abundance. Her name is sometimes read as good mother. Some texts set her against Anu, mother of the gods. In the Fenian Cycle she appears as a warrior woman. She trained the great hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill.

okr.objective: Describe Búanann as a goddess of heroes who trained Fionn Mac Cumhaill.
